features.label: ML engine & pipelines

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Let the contextual embeddings engine shut down when idle

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Give static embeddings their own engineId

features.summary: The contextual embeddings engine can now shut down when it is idle, helping avoid keeping unused machine-learning resources active. Static embeddings also get their own engine identity, so they can be managed separately from other embedding work.

features.label: ML inference engine tests

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Keep ML engines usable after the inference process shuts them down for being idle

features.summary: The tests now check that ML engines remain usable after the inference process shuts down because it has been idle. This helps catch cases where an engine cannot recover when needed again.

features.label: Native text generation

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Move the delta stats into the generate resolve callback in TextGenerator::Generate (Coverity CID 1702186)

features.summary: Text generation now reports its delta statistics as part of the completion callback, alongside the finished result. The change addresses a code-analysis concern and keeps that reporting tied to the generation outcome.

features.label: Page extractor

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Read Google Docs through their /mobilebasic view in PageExtractor.

features.summary: Page extraction can now read Google Docs using their mobile-basic view, making document content available to Firefox’s page-reading tools when the standard view isn’t suitable.

features.label: ML inference engine tests

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Keep ML engines usable after the inference process shuts them down for being idle

patches.author: Giulia Cardieri
patches.subject: Abort AITab generation when the chat stop button is clicked

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 5: Test llama.cpp on the Metal GPU of the macOS CI machines.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 3: Let the device pipeline option place a text generation.

patches.author: Mark Banner
patches.subject: Switch from eslint-plugin-import to eslint-plugin-import-x (comment-only changes for ESLint).

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Test native ONNX session memory growth and engine cleanup after initialization failure.

patches.author: Alex G
patches.subject: [Monitor Agent][Models] Preserve the MLPA 429 error code so monitors can tell an exhausted budget from rate limiting

features.summary: The ML inference tests now cover engines recovering after idle shutdown, stopping AI Tab generation when the user clicks stop, and text generation on device-selected pipelines, including llama.cpp on Mac GPUs. They also check ONNX memory cleanup and preserve a distinct error code when a model budget is exhausted, helping ensure failures are handled and reported clearly.

features.label: ML engine & pipelines

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Let the contextual embeddings engine shut down when idle

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Give static embeddings their own engineId

patches.author: Damien Carver
patches.subject: Replace prefix: with logModule: in the console.createInstance calls (Automatic fixes).

patches.author: Damien Carver
patches.subject: Rename the "ML:OpenAIPipeline" and "ML:LlamaCppPipeline" log modules to "GeckoMLOpenAIPipeline" and "GeckoMLLlamaCppPipeline".

patches.author: Fred Chasen
patches.subject: Add a widget-generation ML feature, service type and purpose

patches.author: Andrea Marchesini
patches.subject: Create an abstraction layer around the auth flow for smartwindow

features.summary: Machine-learning pipelines can now release the contextual embeddings engine when idle, and static embeddings have a separate engine identity. The changes also add a widget-generation ML feature and clarify how Smart Window handles authentication, making these capabilities easier to manage as distinct parts of Firefox’s ML system.

features.label: about:inference page

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Stop reading the device pipeline option.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 3: Text generation panel in about:inference.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 2: Sub-tabs and a devices panel in about:inference.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: about:inference fixes for HWInference engines.

features.summary: The about:inference page, a built-in view for inspecting machine-learning inference, is being expanded with device panels and controls for text generation. The changes also fix issues with hardware-accelerated inference engines and stop the page from reading an outdated device-pipeline option.

features.label: Native text generation

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Move the delta stats into the generate resolve callback in TextGenerator::Generate (Coverity CID 1702186)

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 2: Let a TextGenerator choose its device through a placement.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Keep callable alive during TextGeneration callback

features.summary: Text generation can now choose a device through a placement setting, allowing work to be directed to suitable hardware. The changes also keep the generation callback available until it has finished and report delta statistics with the completed result.

features.label: Page extractor

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Read Google Docs through their /mobilebasic view in PageExtractor.

patches.author: MoHan Zhang
patches.subject: Keep the URLs of anchors around block content in extracted page text

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Give monitor checks time to settle before reading pages

features.summary: Page extraction now supports Google Docs through their mobile-basic view and keeps links attached to content when extracting it. It also gives monitor checks time to settle before reading a page, helping avoid incomplete results.

features.label: ML IPC

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: List the inference devices of the HWInference process.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Fix --disable-webspeech.

features.summary: The hardware inference process can now report which devices are available for machine-learning tasks, helping Firefox identify where inference can run. The web-speech disable option was also corrected so it works as intended.

features.label: ML actors

patches.author: Fred Chasen
patches.subject: Update EngineDispatcher to only be idle when nothing is running.

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Release native ONNX inference outputs and metadata. Release engines and workers after initialization failure.

features.summary: The ML engine dispatcher now reports itself as idle only when no work is running, so active inference is not mistaken for an available engine. The changes also release ONNX inference outputs and metadata, and clean up engines and workers when initialization fails, helping prevent resources from lingering.

features.label: Page extractor tests

patches.author: calixteman
patches.subject: Reject pending PDF text requests on actor destruction.

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Let headless extractor tests fire the load deadline after the navigation instead of racing it

features.summary: Page-extractor tests now check that pending PDF text requests are rejected if their actor is destroyed. The headless tests also wait for page navigation before starting the load deadline, reducing timing-related test failures.

features.label: ML inference engine

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 4: Record the kind of device that loaded a text generation model.

features.summary: Firefox now records what kind of device loaded a text-generation model, such as a CPU or GPU. This makes it easier to understand which hardware is being used when a model runs.

features.label: ML inference engine docs

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: no bug - docs: use internal references for in-tree docs instead of firefox-source-docs URLs DONTBUILD

features.summary: The ML inference engine documentation now links to other in-tree documentation using internal references instead of external Firefox-source-docs URLs. This keeps documentation links within the project and easier to maintain.
